Amarnath and Vaishno Devi Yatras Suspended Due to Weather Alert

The Amarnath and Vaishno Devi pilgrimages have been temporarily suspended starting July 19 due to a weather alert issued by the India Meteorological Department. This suspension aims to ensure the safety of pilgrims amidst forecasts of inclement weather. The decision comes as rescue operations are underway in Jammu following flash floods, with some pilgrims also sustaining injuries in separate road accidents along the Jammu-Srinagar highway.
